verdict.rationale: Retell's voice docs let developers search and add ElevenLabs community voices from the voice selector, import or train voice clones (up to 25 audio files via API), and set the voice as a core agent setting. The founder confirms multiple TTS providers (OpenAI TTS, Deepgram, ElevenLabs) at different prices. missing for 10: a first-party documented list of supported TTS providers, evidence of plugging in your own TTS provider or API key, and independent hands-on corroboration of library breadth.
